body: Introducing The Summit Ascend, a custom-built Mercedes Sprinter 170 AWD camper van created by Papago Vans for a private client. This one-of-a-kind build is designed to combine rugged off-road capability with the comfort and luxury of a modern home, making it the ultimate adventure vehicle for those who demand the best in van life.

Equipped with a powerful 400W solar system, 800Ah lithium battery, and 3000W pure sine wave inverter, The Summit Ascend ensures reliable off-grid power for every journey. The Agile Off Road Lift Kit, all-terrain tires, and CA Tuned front bumper enable seamless navigation of challenging trails, while the electric awning with integrated LED lighting and perimeter lights add convenience and safety for remote camping.

Inside, The Summit Ascend features a sleek and modern design with whitewashed wood ceilings, painted shiplap walls, and dimmable LED lighting, creating a bright and inviting living space. The fully equipped kitchen includes a double burner induction cooktop, 700W microwave, and Isotherm Cruise 130 refrigerator with freezer, making it ideal for preparing meals on the go.

For rest and relaxation, this van includes a queen-size memory foam bed, custom storage solutions, and a foldable table for added versatility. Every detail has been carefully tailored to meet the client’s needs, making this van both functional and elegant.

The Summit Ascend showcases the exceptional craftsmanship and customization options available here at Papago Vans. If you’re ready to create your dream camper van, contact us to start your journey today!
